name: High Power Conversion for Electric Vehicles
description: Overview on applications of high-power converters in electric transportation – fast charging, high power propulsion, basic rectifier systems; multipulse rectifiers; active rectifiers; EMI/EMC issues and need of resonant converter topologies; popular multilevel converter topologies for high power applications, and modular multilevel converter topologies; multilevel space vectors and modulation schemes; polygonal voltage space vectors using multilevel converters- 12-sided, 24-sided space vector structures; high power topologies – applications for fast charging; renewable integration high-power charging stations; onboard hybrid power generation architectures for propulsion; high power converters for rail and aircraft systems- conventional and modular multilevel powertrain architecture for railway tractions, electric aircraft propulsion, power generation architectures for more electric aircraft system.
